task: Email verification and password reset, as in HLD section 5.5
acceptance: Single-use tokens stored hashed, reset links expire in 30 minutes; the forgot route answers the same for unknown emails; a reset revokes every session; emails printed to the console in development; an unverified account cannot create or approve a job (D-036)
evidence: Verify-email, resend, forgot, reset/check, reset per HLD 5.5: tokens stored as SHA-256, consumed by one compare-and-set UPDATE (race test: one winner); reset is one transaction (token, hash, sessions revoked, audit) and rolls back as a whole; 24 h / 30 min expiry tested at the boundary; forgot answers identically for unknown, suspended and real accounts; a reset also confirms the email. tests/test_auth_tokens.py (24); backend/check.sh: 138 passed. Not covered: timing of forgot for real vs unknown accounts; no real email provider.

task: Jobs belong to a user; protect every job and media route
acceptance: Another user's job returns 404
evidence: Migration 0003: jobs.user_id (nullable, FK users ON DELETE SET NULL, indexed); ownerless jobs kept and never shown. Every /jobs route needs a session (401); lookups by id AND owner, so another user's, missing and ownerless jobs give the same 404 job_not_found, media included; create and approve need a confirmed email (403 email_not_verified). Compare-and-set, restart recovery and no-retry tests unchanged in meaning. tests/test_job_access.py; backend/check.sh: 148 passed with T-203. Frontend types regenerated. The current create screen gets 401 until T-211 adds login to the app.

task: Rate limits and origin check
acceptance: Repeated bad logins are throttled; cross-site POST refused
evidence: In-process sliding-window limiter (D-035): login 5 failures per email+address per 15 min (success clears; full counter refuses even the right password), sign-up 5 per address per hour, forgot and resend 3 per email and 10 per address per hour each; 429 rate_limited with Retry-After; forgot's 429 identical for real and unknown emails. OriginMiddleware refuses POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE with a foreign Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site (403 origin_refused); AVATAR_ALLOWED_ORIGINS. tests/test_rate_limits.py, tests/test_origin.py; backend/check.sh: 171 passed. Not verified: real browser headers, a real proxy, more than one process; in development all requests share 127.0.0.1.
